grok-2-1.summary: The inline fidelity property incorrectly requires every original harvested span to be a valid bare-line reference, despite their distinct whitespace grammars.
grok-2-1.fix: Assert parseBareLineReference(stringifyBare(hit)) against the projected keyword and issue number instead of parsing the original slice. Retain normalization and exact-offset checks, add structured inline-only opening whitespace including newline, and preserve both parser grammars and upstream cases.

fable-2-1.summary: Measured equivalent-output parser paths remain about 1.3–1.9x slower than upstream after the round-1 fix.
fable-2-1.fix: Measure behavior-preserving lookup and allocation improvements in ClosingList.ts and IssueReferences.ts against the pinned oracle with alternating benchmark repetitions. Evaluate widened Enum records, miss-path R.has/hit-path R.get, capture-based extraction and reduced Option/map allocation; if necessary use a schema-backed item/unsafe/miss scanner union with a shared miss value, retaining public Option boundaries. Preserve grammar, offsets, order, unsafe-number handling and existing regression tests; introduce no native collections, nullish domain sentinels or unsafe casts. Deliver measured improvement and output-equivalence evidence to the orchestrator; do not edit the ledger or Port notes.

fable-2-2.summary: Five result schemas admit negative issue numbers/offsets or empty issue lists that their parser grammar excludes.
fable-2-2.fix: Use S.Natural for issue numbers and offsets in IssueReferences.ts and ClosingList.ts and S.NonEmptyArray(S.Natural) for the three list models, preserving annotations. Read the first valid item before creating non-empty parser accumulators and carry that invariant without casts. Add schema boundary acceptance/rejection cases in both existing parser test files and retain refined-schema round trips in both property files. Preserve parser outputs and every upstream case; leave numeric-domain deviation bookkeeping to the central codemod.
